author: Brad Arnett (CodePen: bradarnett)
implementation: Drawing-only extraction; 3D scene, pencil, model loading and color palette removed from active code per user request.
features: Save opens drawing PNG in a new tab
integration: Serve index.html with sketch.css and sketch.js. No external runtime dependencies.

dependencies.font: Declared original font family falls back to browser font; no external font service loaded.

adaptations: Fixed original undefined initial-dot radius to existing minThickness.
Guarded WebGL renderer creation; model mathematics and 2D drawing remain active without a rendered pencil when WebGL is unavailable. Status explicitly reports limitation.
Drawing canvas resizes and preserves existing pixels during viewport changes.
Model loading status shown during initialization.
Explicit page width/height keeps controls positioned in canvas-only mode.
Removed 3D pencil and all WebGL/Three.js initialization, custom cursor and palette. Retained drawing thickness interpolation and drawing-only Save behavior.

validation.isolated: Drawing, finite radii, Clear and original PNG export passed without Three.js.
validation.live_page: Verified one canvas, regular auto cursor, no palette and no external scripts; drew black stroke and cleared it.

archived_dependencies.loaders: Original loader URLs on assets.codepen.io failed shell fetch; same author's original S3 files fetched successfully and included locally.
archived_dependencies.font: Original Galano Grotesque Semi Bold trial font service inaccessible; browser fallback font used, service script excluded.
archived_dependencies.jquery: Present in original external settings but unused by feature; excluded.
